next_step_summary: Draft PR #230 is an explicitly product-owner-authorized Cloud Run CPU latency experiment and does not replace the canonical serverless-GPU architecture or next production step. It packages Surya 2 GGUF plus its multimodal projector inside a CPU-only image, starts a pinned llama.cpp server on loopback, reuses one Surya engine, exposes a bounded aggregate-only benchmark wrapper, and provides a me-west1-only Cloud Run template for 8 vCPU, 16 GiB, min 0, max 1, concurrency 1, and startup CPU boost. Only approved non-identifying benchmark pages are authorized. The PR must remain Draft until a real Cloud Run deployment measures scale-to-zero cold request latency, warm latency, OCR time, startup behavior, counts, CPU/RAM/OOM behavior, provider log hygiene, cleanup, retention, and actual regional behavior. The canonical next_step_id intentionally remains surya-raw-fullframe-gpu-execution-v1, with no production upload, authentication, encryption/key management, PII masking, Gemini/legal-analysis call, storage, billing, multi-region fallback, or final CPU architecture decision authorized by PR #230.
